title: Hay Bale
text: Hay Bale A Hay Bale is a 'contraption' item which is used in crafting. Items crafted with Hay Bale are: Smoke Bead Used to repair attacked beehives Combined Feed Feed for larger livestock and pens Eco-Friendly Fuel for increasing speed of vehicles and ships Square Brick Flowerbed A decor item Racing Zebra Chow Converts Zebra to Racing Zebra Hay Bales are obtained as a drop through harvesting Seeds and Seed Bundles under the Farming Proficiency. They are also harvested from the roof of Miner's Farmhouse, Rancher's Farmhouse, and Harvester's Farmhouse.
